tool.name: Amber to Gromacs
tool.description: converts Amber topology and coordinate files to Gromacs format
tool.command:
ln -s $prmtop system.prmtop && ln -s $inpcrd system.inpcrd &&
python '$__tool_directory__/amb_to_gro.py' --prmtop system.prmtop --inpcrd system.inpcrd
--output_top system.top --output_gro system.gro
&&
mv system.top '$output_top' && mv system.gro '$output_gro'

param.name: prmtop
param.label: AMBER Parm7 topology file
param.help: Select the AMBER Parm7 topology file (.parm7) containing force field parameters and molecular structure.

param.name: inpcrd
param.label: AMBER Rst7 coordinate file
param.help: Select the AMBER Rst7 coordinate file (.rst7) containing atomic positions and system geometry.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
This tool converts Amber topology (.prmtop) and coordinate (.inpcrd) files to GROMACS topology (.top) and structure (.gro) files using ParmEd.
This is useful when you have parameterized a system in Amber (e.g., using AmberTools or the Membrane Builder tool) and want to run molecular dynamics simulations in GROMACS.
-----
**Input Requirements**
- **Amber topology file (.prmtop)**: Contains force field parameters, atom types, bond information, and molecular topology - **Amber coordinate file (.inpcrd)**: Contains atomic coordinates and box dimensions
-----
**Outputs**
- **GROMACS topology (.top)**: Converted topology file containing force field parameters, atom definitions, and molecular structure information compatible with GROMACS - **GROMACS structure (.gro)**: Converted coordinate file containing atom positions and box vectors in GROMACS format
-----
**How it works**
The tool uses ParmEd, a powerful library for editing and converting molecular dynamics parameter/topology files. ParmEd reads the Amber parameter and coordinate files and writes equivalent GROMACS files while preserving:
- Force field parameters (bonds, angles, dihedrals, non-bonded interactions) - Atom types and charges - Residue definitions - Box dimensions and periodicity
-----
**Notes**
- Ensure your Amber files are complete and properly formatted before conversion - Some advanced Amber features may not have direct GROMACS equivalents - The converted topology may require manual adjustments for complex systems - Position restraint files (.itp) may need to be generated separately
